name: Braums
source:
A no-nonsense, (okay, maybe a little nonsense) nobleman, who's as condescending as he is colorful. He's rich, he's arrogant, and all he wants is for Paris to stop flirting with him.

[From [url=https://harlevin.itch.io/thepretendersguild]itch.io[/url]]
